body:
Split the Settings page into three tabs, in this order: **Agents**, **Appearance**, **Languages**. Nothing is added or removed from what the page can do; its existing sections move into the tabs.

- **Agents:** Agent behavior, Role models, Models, Skills
- **Appearance:** the Dark mode section
- **Languages:** the Languages section

A message explaining a refused change must still be seen whichever tab is showing.

Update the settings README to match. The code is `settings.view` in `solace-cli/settings`; the Strategy page (`strategy.view`, `strategy.tabs`) already has tabs to follow.

**Tests:** each tab shows its own sections and no others, and all three tabs are listed in order.
title: settings: Agents, Appearance, Languages tabs
